entry.title: Cold-end air preheater fouling shows as a widening flue-gas / air temperature gap
entry.statement: A slowly widening gap between rising economizer flue-gas outlet temperature (TE_8319A/B) and falling secondary-air preheater outlet temperature (TE_8304) indicates cold-end air-preheater fouling, well before either alarm trips.
entry.body:
During a backpass fouling review the flue-gas outlet temperature crept up while the secondary-air preheater outlet temperature drifted down over three days. The two moving in opposite directions is the signature of cold-end deposits reducing heat transfer.

Per trb_backpass_fouling: trend the temperature gap rather than either tag alone.
corrective_actions: Trend the TE_8319A/B minus TE_8304 gap daily; schedule soot-blowing when it widens beyond 15 degC.
Inspect the cold-end baskets per mnt_air_preheater_inspection at the next outage.

groundings.note: air preheater sits in this system
